name: Usage question

title: "[QUESTION] "
labels: question
assignees: ''
---

## What are you trying to do?

One or two sentences — e.g. "attach Mission Control to my relay", "run a
guided test session", "why is Cancel run nacked".

## What did you try?

Steps taken and relevant configuration (redact tokens and private paths):

```sh
...
```

## What happened instead?

Output, error text, or behavior you did not expect.

## Where did the docs fall short?

If you looked at the README, a `docs/testing` guide, or another doc and it
didn't answer this, name it — unanswerable questions are documentation bugs
too.

> Questions about the normative protocol text itself (what an emitter MUST
> do, envelope semantics) belong on the
> [standard repository](https://github.com/agenteventprotocol/agent-event-protocol/issues/new/choose).
